title: A crossing into PROVEME refuses while either tree carries uncommitted changes
intention: A forward crossing into PROVEME refuses while the build_inspector's working_tree_clean sieve finds any uncommitted change in either tree, so a proof is never taken over another ticket's loose work.
why: Ruling 8x (Akien, verbatim: "yes to all."), item 3e, under 8w ("yes, rework them that way. and cc++") and F11 ("that all sounds good :)"), /home/akien/.cairn/foreground-decisions.md. The /sail sweep (92e0d158b1bc) cleans the tree at the start of a voyage, and the build gate checks it at the end, but dirt written after /sail and committed before PROVED (the 8t gap the peer reported) would still be under the proof and seal. Seating the check at PROVEME entry means the proof is never taken over another ticket's loose work.
traces_to: Law 8 and ruling 8t (the proof and seal must not be taken over another ticket's unproved build; PROVEME entry is where the build's proof is named); Law 7 (the dirt is loud at the door); Law 4 (physics at the chokepoint every crossing passes). RULE 1: the seat lives in base and reaches build_inspector only through its declared interface.
how: (a) a new `class WorkingTreeDirtyRed(IllegalTransition)` beside ProofNamedRed in transitions.py. (b) In emit(), directly after the proof-named seat block: `if target == 'PROVEME' and target_idx > wf.cursor:` import working_tree_clean from cairn.machines.build_inspector.inspector, comp_dir = Path(history_path).resolve().parent, findings = working_tree_clean({'component': comp_dir.name}, comp_dir). If findings: raise WorkingTreeDirtyRed with a message listing every path in findings[0]['values']['dirty'] per repo, plus the disposition 'commit it into its ticket, or stash it (python3 -m skills.sail.sweep), then cross again'. Else append to `proved` a lane {'method': 'working_tree_clean', 'about': comp_dir.name, 'expected': True, 'actual': True, ...} in the shape the other seats' lanes use (copy the shape from the proof-named seat's record). (c) The seat runs only when history_path and state_path are given (inside the same branch as the other seats). (d) Proof file cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_proveme_entry_needs_a_clean_tree.py with PROVES keyed on 11cd253f10bc, clauses 1-3, one tooth each; fixtures under scratch_dir; git with `-c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t`; a ticketless crossing (no ticket kwarg) so the BUILDME/proof-named seats record not_checked. PROOF_TIMEOUT_S = 120. Run only via bin/cairn test --netns.

decisions.text: cairn/tools/base/transitions.py is the ONLY file the build writes. (1) class WorkingTreeDirtyRed(IllegalTransition) directly after ProofNamedRed, __init__(self, message, findings=None) storing self.findings = findings or [], docstring citing ticket 11cd253f10bc and 8t/8w/F11/8x. (2) def inspect_clean_tree(comp_dir: Path) -> tuple[list[dict], list[dict]]: lazily 'from cairn.machines.build_inspector.inspector import working_tree_clean' (build_inspector's declared public_interface — RULE 1), findings = working_tree_clean({'component': comp_dir.name}, comp_dir); returns (findings, [one _lane('working_tree_clean', expected=shown, actual=shown if no findings else a sentence naming the dirty count, code='transitions.py::inspect_clean_tree', component=comp_dir.name, dirty=<findings[0] values dirty or {}>)]). (3) def _clean_tree_gate(comp_dir) -> tuple[str, list[dict]]: on findings raise WorkingTreeDirtyRed with a message naming the component and, per repo, every dirty path (repo dir then its paths), ending 'commit it into its ticket, or stash it (python3 -m skills.sail.sweep), then cross again', findings=the sieve's findings; else return ('clean — both trees committed at the PROVEME entry of <name>', record). (4) In emit, directly after the proof-named seat block and inside the same 'if history_path and state_path:' branch: tree_note = None; if target == 'PROVEME' and target_idx > wf.cursor: tree_note, _rec = _clean_tree_gate(Path(history_path).resolve().parent); proved += _rec. It runs for ticketless crossings too (the clauses cross ticketless). (5) The record gains '**({"tree_gate": tree_note} if tree_note else {})' directly after the proof_gate line. (6) A ScanRefused from the sieve propagates loud (Law 7). Back-edges are ungated like every sibling seat.

decisions.text: Folds D2 and D3 (F16, cleared by the peer for Akien, his to overturn). Measured 2026-10-08: test_transitions.py:1437 crosses into PROVEME from a non-git tempfile.TemporaryDirectory; working_tree_clean walks to /, finds no .git and returns [] without calling repo_truth, so D2's seat wrote a PASSING working_tree_clean lane over input it never read, a vacuous green (316b, gates-are-hard). D2 is folded on one point: inspect_clean_tree first asks whether comp_dir or any of its parents holds .git; when NONE does it returns ([], []) without calling the sieve, and _clean_tree_gate then returns ('not_checked: no git repo holds <comp_dir>', []), so the record carries tree_gate with that reason and NO working_tree_clean lane. This applies ONLY when no repo holds the dir: a dir inside a repo that fails to read still reaches the sieve, and its ScanRefused propagates red (D2 (6)). D3 is folded: test_transitions.py is NOT edited (F15's edit is withdrawn); its 3-lane tooth stays green unchanged because the tempdir crossing now writes no lane. A falsifier clause (4) is added by this line: a comp/ under scratch_dir with no .git in it or any parent crosses ticketless BUILDME->PROVEME, lands at PROVEME, its record carries no lane with identity working_tree_clean, and its tree_gate starts 'not_checked: no git repo holds'. Its tooth is test_a_dir_no_repo_holds_crosses_not_checked_with_no_lane, PROVES clause '4' in the same proof file. Teeth 1-3 still pin the lane over a real component: their <tmp>/cairn and <tmp>/CairnCommons are real git repos read through repo_truth, though under scratch_dir and not the live trees.
